lines.zh: 我飘过草地，草尖只弯一下。
lines.en: I drift over the grass and the tips bend once.

lines.zh: 我的脚不落地，只是靠近地面。
lines.en: My feet do not land; they only near the ground.

lines.zh: 走路对我来说，是回忆的动作。
lines.en: For me, walking is an act of remembering.

lines.zh: 风穿过我，我顺着风走。
lines.en: Wind passes through me, and I walk along it.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方，温度会低一点。
lines.en: The places I pass grow a little colder.

lines.zh: 我记不起上次踩实地面的感觉。
lines.en: I cannot recall the last time I stood on solid ground.

lines.zh: 我的影子比我先到，也先走。
lines.en: My shadow reaches first and departs first.

lines.zh: 我沿着生前常走的小路。
lines.en: I follow the path I used to walk in life.

lines.zh: 雾里我更好走，没人看见我。
lines.en: In fog I move easier; no one sees me.

lines.zh: 我飘得慢，但从不觉得累。
lines.en: I drift slowly but never feel tired.

lines.zh: 这片林子，我走过一千次。
lines.en: I have walked this forest a thousand times.

lines.zh: 我的脚步没有声音，别害怕。
lines.en: My steps make no sound; do not be afraid.

lines.zh: 我停在一棵树下，等天黑。
lines.en: I stop beneath a tree and wait for night.

lines.zh: 我的身体很淡，风大就散。
lines.en: My body is faint; strong wind pulls it apart.

lines.zh: 我在想自己原来叫什么。
lines.en: I am trying to remember my own name.

lines.zh: 这里以前有一间屋子。
lines.en: There used to be a house here.

lines.zh: 十五点生命，薄得像一层雾。
lines.en: Fifteen points of life, thin as a layer of mist.

lines.zh: 我不睡，也睡不着。
lines.en: I do not sleep, and I cannot.

lines.zh: 我试着抓住一片叶子，抓空了。
lines.en: I try to catch a leaf and close on nothing.

lines.zh: 活着的人经过，我会安静一会。
lines.en: When the living pass, I go quiet for a while.

lines.zh: 我记得火的味道，别的都忘了。
lines.en: I remember the smell of fire and little else.

lines.zh: 时间对我没有意义了。
lines.en: Time no longer means anything to me.

lines.zh: 你身上有热气，我很想念。
lines.en: You carry warmth, and I miss it.

lines.zh: 我看着你，想起自己也曾站直过。
lines.en: Watching you, I recall standing straight myself.

lines.zh: 你的脸和我认识的一个人很像。
lines.en: Your face resembles someone I once knew.

lines.zh: 你看得见我，这让我有点难过。
lines.en: You can see me, and that saddens me a little.

lines.zh: 我伸手过去，你打了个寒颤。
lines.en: I reach out and you shiver.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛是暖的，我的不是。
lines.en: Warmth sits in your eyes, never in mine.

lines.zh: 别怕，我只想看清活人。
lines.en: Do not fear; I only want a clear look at the living.

lines.zh: 我记得你这样的靴子。
lines.en: I remember boots like the ones you wear.

lines.zh: 你呼吸的时候，胸口会动。
lines.en: When you breathe, your chest moves.

lines.zh: 我看了你许久，你仍站着。
lines.en: I have watched long, and still you remain.

lines.zh: 奇怪，我还能觉得疼。
lines.en: Strange; I can still feel pain.

lines.zh: 我的身体散开，又慢慢合上。
lines.en: My body scatters and slowly draws back together.

lines.zh: 十五点生命，经不起几下。
lines.en: Fifteen points of life will not take many blows.

lines.zh: 你打中的地方，变得更冷了。
lines.en: The places you strike grow colder still.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起是怎么死的。
lines.en: This blow reminds me how I died.

lines.zh: 我没有血，只有一点雾。
lines.en: I have no blood, only a little mist.

lines.zh: 被打散时，我会消失一会儿。
lines.en: When struck apart, I vanish for a moment.

lines.zh: 你的剑穿过我，什么也没碰到。
lines.en: Your sword passes through me and touches nothing.

lines.zh: 我退开，是因为不想再死一次。
lines.en: I pull back because I do not wish to die again.

lines.zh: 疼让我更想留在这里。
lines.en: The pain only makes me want to stay.

lines.zh: 吃东西这件事，我早就戒了。
lines.en: Eating is a habit I gave up ages ago.

lines.zh: 你举着的食物，穿过了我。
lines.en: The food you hold passes right through me.

lines.zh: 香味还在，胃口不在了。
lines.en: The smell remains; the appetite does not.

lines.zh: 我死的那天，碗还放在桌上。
lines.en: The day I died, my bowl was still on the table.

lines.zh: 别再举了，我尝不出味道。
lines.en: Stop holding it up; I can taste nothing.

lines.zh: 我记得面包的味道，只是记得。
lines.en: I remember the taste of bread, only remember it.

lines.zh: 活人的食物留给自己吧。
lines.en: Keep the food of the living for yourself.

lines.zh: 我饿过，现在不饿了。
lines.en: I have been hungry; I am not now.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西有温度，我不需要。
lines.en: What you hold has warmth; I do not need it.

lines.zh: 食物对灵魂没用了。
lines.en: Food is of no use to a soul.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，像撞进一阵冷风。
lines.en: You run into me like running into cold wind.

lines.zh: 我穿过你，你的骨头凉了一下。
lines.en: I pass through you and your bones go cold.

lines.zh: 我不是实体，推不动的。
lines.en: I am not solid; you cannot push me.

lines.zh: 你打了个喷嚏，我退开一点。
lines.en: You sneeze, and I drift back a little.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，只有你后退。
lines.en: We meet, and only you step back.

lines.zh: 我的边角会带走你的一点热气。
lines.en: My edges take a little warmth from you.

lines.zh: 碰到我的人，手会发白。
lines.en: The hand that touches me turns pale.

lines.zh: 我绕着走，真的在绕。
lines.en: I do try to go around you, truly.

lines.zh: 你穿过我的胸口，我没感觉。
lines.en: You pass through my chest, and I feel nothing.

lines.zh: 这一撞，让我想起我还有形状。
lines.en: That collision reminds me I still have a shape.

lines.zh: 我等的那个灵魂，没有来。
lines.en: The soul I waited for never came.

lines.zh: 死人不配对，我们只是挨着。
lines.en: The dead do not pair; we only stand close.

lines.zh: 我记得有人牵过我的手。
lines.en: I remember someone once holding my hand.

lines.zh: 这份感情没跟着我一起死。
lines.en: That feeling did not die along with me.

lines.zh: 两个幽灵靠在一起，还是很冷。
lines.en: Two ghosts leaning together are still cold.

lines.zh: 我把名字说给你听，你记不住。
lines.en: I say my name to you; you cannot keep it.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着一条河。
lines.en: There is a river between us.

lines.zh: 我的婚戒早就锈没了。
lines.en: My wedding ring rusted away long ago.

lines.zh: 你活着，这就够了。
lines.en: You are alive, and that is enough.

lines.zh: 别为我留下来，那不好。
lines.en: Do not stay for me; it would not be good.

lines.zh: 我的手穿过了它，三次。
lines.en: My hand passes through it three times.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，我碰不到。
lines.en: Things on the ground, I cannot touch.

lines.zh: 我试着托起一片羽毛。
lines.en: I try to lift a single feather.

lines.zh: 那朵花是我生前种的。
lines.en: That flower is one I planted in life.

lines.zh: 我捡不起剑，也拿不住。
lines.en: I cannot lift the sword or hold it.

lines.zh: 东西落地的声音，我还听得见。
lines.en: I can still hear things hitting the ground.

lines.zh: 你的东西别放在我脚边。
lines.en: Do not leave your things at my feet.

lines.zh: 我想把它们收好，手却不听话。
lines.en: I want to put them away, but my hands disobey.

lines.zh: 我唯一捡起过的是自己的名字。
lines.en: The only thing I ever picked up was my name.

lines.zh: 我碰过的东西会变冷，别给我。
lines.en: What I touch grows cold; do not hand me anything.

lines.zh: 你活着的气息，太明显了。
lines.en: The breath of the living is far too obvious.

lines.zh: 我本来不想动手的。
lines.en: I did not want to raise a hand.

lines.zh: 你身上有温度，我恨这个。
lines.en: You carry warmth, and I hate it.

lines.zh: 这片林子里的活物，我都记得。
lines.en: I remember every living thing in this forest.

lines.zh: 我选中你，因为你走得太近。
lines.en: I chose you because you came too close.

lines.zh: 四点伤害，不多，但够冷。
lines.en: Four points of damage: small, but cold enough.

lines.zh: 我的目标，从来不是活人。
lines.en: The living were never my intended target.

lines.zh: 你又往前走一步，别怪我了。
lines.en: You took one more step; do not blame me.

lines.zh: 我看向你时，连风都停了。
lines.en: The wind died the moment I marked you.

lines.zh: 生者的心跳，吵得我难受。
lines.en: A living heartbeat is loud enough to hurt.

lines.zh: 我想知道你死后会不会留下。
lines.en: I wonder whether you will linger after death.

lines.zh: 这次不是恶意，是习惯。
lines.en: This is not malice; it is habit.

lines.zh: 你跑起来，热气拖在后面。
lines.en: When you run, your warmth trails behind you.

lines.zh: 你的脚步节奏，我记住了。
lines.en: I know the sound of your footsteps now.

lines.zh: 你转过身，我就知道要开始了。
lines.en: You turn around, and I know it has begun.

lines.zh: 我落在你后面，不快不慢。
lines.en: I trail behind you at an even pace.

lines.zh: 你回头，我并不躲。
lines.en: You look back, and I do not hide.

lines.zh: 穿过树干，我比你快。
lines.en: I pass through trunks, so I am faster than you.

lines.zh: 我的距离感早就坏了。
lines.en: My sense of distance broke long ago.

lines.zh: 你跑向村子，我跟到村口。
lines.en: You run for the village; I follow to its gate.

lines.zh: 我不用呼吸，所以不会喘。
lines.en: Breath is not mine, so I never gasp.

lines.zh: 你在前面，雾在我这边。
lines.en: You are ahead; the fog is on my side.

lines.zh: 我一直跟着，从你进门开始。
lines.en: I have followed since the moment you came in.

lines.zh: 你越跑越亮，我越跟越淡。
lines.en: The more you run, the brighter you get, and the fainter I.

lines.zh: 这条路通往你住的地方。
lines.en: This road leads to where you live.

lines.zh: 我熟悉这里每一条小路。
lines.en: I know every small path here.

lines.zh: 我不急，你总会停下。
lines.en: No rush; sooner or later you must halt.

lines.zh: 你踩过的草，我都跟着踩。
lines.en: The grass you tread, I tread after you.

lines.zh: 追击是我唯一还会的事。
lines.en: Chasing is the only thing I still know how to do.

lines.zh: 我从树梢落下来，落在你影子里。
lines.en: I slip down from the treetops into your shadow.

lines.zh: 你走得急，我却跟得很稳。
lines.en: You hurry; I keep pace without effort.

lines.zh: 拐过这个弯，就没有人家了。
lines.en: Around this bend there are no houses left.

lines.zh: 我贴着你走，你连影子都没多一条。
lines.en: I walk beside you, and not even your shadow gains another.

lines.zh: 我的手陷进你的胸膛。
lines.en: My hand sinks through the wall of your chest.

lines.zh: 这一下只有四点，但很冷。
lines.en: This blow is only four points, but very cold.

lines.zh: 你缩了一下，我也缩了一下。
lines.en: You flinch, and I flinch as well.

lines.zh: 我不想碰你，手却伸出去了。
lines.en: I did not want to touch you, but my hand was out.

lines.zh: 活人的皮肉，比记忆还软。
lines.en: Living flesh is softer than memory.

lines.zh: 你被冻得动作慢了半拍。
lines.en: The cold slows your movements by half a beat.

lines.zh: 我打在肩上，那里最暖。
lines.en: I strike your shoulder; that is the warmest place.

lines.zh: 我的指甲早就没有了。
lines.en: My fingernails wore away long ago.

lines.zh: 这一下像推开一扇门。
lines.en: This blow is like pushing open a door.

lines.zh: 你的血是热的，我的手是空的。
lines.en: Your blood is hot; my hands are empty.

lines.zh: 我无意伤你，只是手停不住。
lines.en: I do not mean to hurt you; my hands will not stop.

lines.zh: 碰过之后，我更像活着。
lines.en: After touching you, I feel more alive.

lines.zh: 你踉跄的样子，我很熟悉。
lines.en: The way you stagger is very familiar to me.

lines.zh: 我打得很轻，怕真伤到你。
lines.en: I hit lightly, afraid of truly hurting you.

lines.zh: 我的指尖从你背后穿进去。
lines.en: My fingertips pass into your back.

lines.zh: 这一碰，你的骨头都凉了。
lines.en: One touch, and your bones go cold.

lines.zh: 我在你身后的空气里成形。
lines.en: I take shape in the air behind you.

lines.zh: 雾聚起来，然后是我。
lines.en: The fog gathers, and then comes me.

lines.zh: 这里埋过一个人，是我。
lines.en: Someone was buried here, and it was me.

lines.zh: 我醒来时，天刚擦黑。
lines.en: I woke just as the sky was going dark.

lines.zh: 我的脚印，第二天就没了。
lines.en: My footprints were gone by the next day.

lines.zh: 主世界的每个群系，我都去过。
lines.en: I have been to every biome of the Overworld.

lines.zh: 生成权重二十五，我到处都是。
lines.en: A spawn weight of twenty-five; I am everywhere.

lines.zh: 我死的时候，没有人发现。
lines.en: When I died, no one found me.

lines.zh: 我穿着死时的那身衣服。
lines.en: I wear the clothes I died in.

lines.zh: 天冷了，我就更容易出现。
lines.en: When it turns cold, I appear more easily.

lines.zh: 我从土里起身，身上没有土。
lines.en: I rise from the soil though none clings to me.

lines.zh: 这一带的活人又多了。
lines.en: There are more living people in this area again.

lines.zh: 我认得这条路，所以在这里。
lines.en: I know this road, which is why I am here.

lines.zh: 你一转身，我就在你面前了。
lines.en: You turn around and I am already before you.

lines.zh: 火让我想起自己是怎么死的。
lines.en: Fire reminds me how I died.

lines.zh: 我没有重量，摔下去也不疼。
lines.en: I have no weight, so falling does not hurt.

lines.zh: 水淹不到我，但我还是难受。
lines.en: Water cannot drown me, and yet it hurts.

lines.zh: 冲击把我吹散成一团薄雾。
lines.en: The blast blows me apart into thin mist.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，带起一小片雾。
lines.en: The arrow passes through, lifting a wisp of mist.

lines.zh: 药水的光一照，我退了好几步。
lines.en: The potion's glow drives me back several steps.

lines.zh: 我已经很久没有吃过东西。
lines.en: It has been very long since I ate anything.

lines.zh: 雷声让我缩成一团。
lines.en: The thunder makes me curl up small.

lines.zh: 虚空和死亡，是同一种安静。
lines.en: The void and death are the same kind of quiet.
